## Data Exploration

## Analysis GSE173955

Load Library

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(DEXSeq)
library(BiocParallel)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
```

```{r}
load(file='/home/projects/22140/exam_data/exam_functions.Rdata')
```

```{r}
isoform_counts_GSE173955 <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE173955")
```

```{r}
gene_counts_GSE173955 <- extractGeneCountMatrixFromIsoCounts(
  isoform_counts_GSE173955
)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(
  gene_counts_GSE173955,
  "data/processed/GSE173955/gene_counts.rds"
)
```

```{r}
dir.create("data/processed/GSE173955", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

metadata_GSE173955 <- readr::read_csv("data/metadata/GSE173955_metadata_clean.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Control", "AD")),
    sex = factor(tolower(sex)),
    age_scaled = as.numeric(scale(age))
  )

stopifnot(all(metadata_GSE173955$sample_id %in% colnames(gene_counts_GSE173955)))
stopifnot(all(metadata_GSE173955$sample_id %in% colnames(isoform_counts_GSE173955)))

gene_counts_GSE173955 <- gene_counts_GSE173955[, metadata_GSE173955$sample_id]
isoform_counts_GSE173955 <- isoform_counts_GSE173955[, metadata_GSE173955$sample_id]

saveRDS(isoform_counts_GSE173955, "data/processed/GSE173955/isoform_counts.rds")
saveRDS(metadata_GSE173955, "data/processed/GSE173955/metadata_aligned.rds")
```

```{r}
# load the exact transcript-to-gene annotation used by the function
tx2gene_df_GSE173955 <- readr::read_rds(
  "/home/projects/22140/exam_data/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.107.chr_patch_hapl_scaff_tx_info.Rds"
) |> 
  dplyr::select(transcript_id, gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::distinct()
```

```{r}
dds_qc_GSE173955 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(as.matrix(gene_counts_GSE173955)),
  colData = as.data.frame(metadata_GSE173955),
  design = ~ sex + age_scaled + condition
)

keep_genes_qc_GSE173955 <- rowSums(counts(dds_qc_GSE173955) >= 10) >= 3
dds_qc_GSE173955 <- dds_qc_GSE173955[keep_genes_qc_GSE173955, ]

vsd_GSE173955 <- vst(dds_qc_GSE173955, blind = TRUE)
pca_data_GSE173955 <- plotPCA(vsd_GSE173955, intgroup = c("condition", "sex", "age"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar_GSE173955 <- round(100 * attr(pca_data_GSE173955, "percentVar"))

ggplot(pca_data_GSE173955, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = condition, shape = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - GSE173955",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_GSE173955[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_GSE173955[2], "% variance")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
ggplot(pca_data_GSE173955, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = age, shape = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - GSE173955 colored by Age",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_GSE173955[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_GSE173955[2], "% variance")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
vsd_corrected_GSE173955 <- vsd_GSE173955
assay(vsd_corrected_GSE173955) <- limma::removeBatchEffect(
  assay(vsd_GSE173955),
  batch = metadata_GSE173955$sex,
  covariates = metadata_GSE173955$age_scaled,
  design = model.matrix(~ condition, data = metadata_GSE173955)
)

plotPCA(vsd_corrected_GSE173955, intgroup = "condition") +
  ggtitle("PCA - GSE173955 with age and sex correction") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
